records.acceptance: Partial external failure has explicit recovery (PHYS,OPS).

records.requirement: Inventory movement and reservations track units, lot/serial, receipts, returns, transfers and quantity availability with scoped authority.
records.acceptance: Concurrent reservations, duplicate return and wrong-lot dispatch conserve eligible quantities (PHYS).

records.requirement: Commerce order/fulfillment tracks partial confirmation, delivery, return/refund and settlement using policy-bound adapters.
records.acceptance: GJ-05 reconciles returned order and explicit recovery (PHYS,FIN).

records.requirement: Manufacturing BOM/MRP/routing and production movement use approved version and safe external OT boundary.
records.acceptance: Production quantity/cost reconcile; no unsafe control command (PHYS,FIN).

records.requirement: Agriculture/food uses provenance, lot trace, recall, yield and policy-bound claims.
records.acceptance: Recall identifies affected lots with no invented certification (PHYS).

records.requirement: Website builder/CMS provides safe content blocks, versioned headless API, multisite and translation/editorial workflow.
records.acceptance: Approved content version can publish in fa/en without tenant leak (EXT,UX).

records.requirement: Commerce site adds catalog, cart/checkout, order, tax/fulfillment/refund through eligible providers.
records.acceptance: Purchase-to-return balances; unsupported corridor blocks checkout (PHYS,PAY).

records.requirement: SEO metadata/sitemap/canonical/redirect controls are testable; no search ranking guarantee.
records.acceptance: Crawlable artifact and redirect checks (UX).

records.requirement: Industry packs declare dependencies, data types, workflows, permissions, policy and conformance/version.
records.acceptance: Two different packs coexist without tenant bleed (EXT,POL).

records.requirement: Banking integration is bounded to licensed partner APIs; no unlicensed core banking/custody claim.
records.acceptance: Unsupported regulated action denied (POL,FIN).

records.requirement: Edge/offline device replay uses signed identity, bounded queue, conflict policy and no silent money/control actuation.
records.acceptance: Offline duplicate converges or escalates (PHYS,OPS).

records.requirement: Advanced WMS/TMS, industrial control and specialist regulated systems remain partner/future contracts with exit/portability.
records.acceptance: Capability mapped, no false GA (EXT,POL).

records.requirement: Device adapters cover barcode, scanner, camera and printer via declared capability, permission, offline queue and failure handling.
records.acceptance: Duplicate scan does not double movement; denied device cannot print sensitive label (PHYS,AUTH).

records.requirement: Procurement RFQ, purchase order, supplier approval and commitment/receipt lifecycle is separate from customer order.
records.acceptance: Canceled/partial PO releases budget commitment and matches AP/receipt (PHYS,BUD).

records.requirement: Warehouse operations own bin, lot/serial, pick/pack/stocktake and inventory movement authority.
records.acceptance: Wrong-lot/duplicate pick denied; quantity and valuation reconcile (PHYS).

records.requirement: Logistics/shipment tracks carrier, handoff, partial delivery, exception, proof and return independently of stock ledger.
records.acceptance: Lost parcel/partial shipment produces bounded recovery and customer evidence (PHYS).

records.requirement: EAM owns physical asset maintenance schedule, work order, inspection and retirement with safety/OT boundary.
records.acceptance: Overdue maintenance blocks configured unsafe use; digital asset register remains distinct (PHYS,OPS).

records.requirement: Site publication owns verified domains, preview, approval, schedule, rollback and public rendering isolation.
records.acceptance: Invalid publish keeps prior site; lead links CRM with tenant provenance (EXT,UX).

records.requirement: Agriculture/food lot trace and recall notification has a separate authority and source lineage from yield/planning.
records.acceptance: Recalled lot identifies affected deliveries and freezes configured movement without certification claim (PHYS,POL).

records.requirement: Commerce order dispute independently governs buyer/seller claim, evidence, scoped adjudication, settlement hold, decision, appeal and refund/reversal.
records.acceptance: Partial delivery dispute preserves evidence and blocks premature settlement; authorized adjudication reconciles refund and ledger without deleting order history (PHYS,FIN).

records.requirement: Stocktake adjustment and inventory valuation/COGS independently version counting evidence, cost method, period and journal reconciliation.
records.acceptance: Count variance requires approval; receipt/return/revaluation posts balanced corrections and ledger value matches independently computed inventory roll-forward (PHYS,FIN).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Classify every data category and processing flow by purpose, sensitivity, retention and approved minimum fields before collection.
records.acceptance: Forbidden/unnecessary field is rejected at intake and excluded from derived export; classification changes are versioned (DATA,AUTH).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Maintain threat model, SBOM/license/supply-chain controls and vulnerability triage with current applicability review.
records.acceptance: P0/P1 vulnerability blocks release, provenance reconstructs (OPS,AUTO).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Purpose/consent and data-subject rights govern scoped access, correction, export and downstream processor actions.
records.acceptance: Withdrawal/rights request propagates without cross-tenant exposure (DATA,AUTH).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Keep minimal immutable audit envelope separately from erasable personal payload, access and retention controls.
records.acceptance: Erasure does not break accounting evidence or reappear (DATA,FIN).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Residency and cross-border processing use policy-bound location and processor evidence, including backup/support/AI.
records.acceptance: Disallowed processor route denied (POL,DATA).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Target WCAG 2.2 AA across relevant web journeys; keyboard, screen reader, zoom, contrast and errors.
records.acceptance: Human + automation critical flows zero blockers (UX).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Persian RTL/English LTR and accessible number, date, money and bidirectional text are tested.
records.acceptance: GJ-01A completion both languages (UX).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Marketing/website claims carry dated substantiation, scope and expiry; no undocumented ROI, law or ready country.
records.acceptance: Unsupported claim cannot publish (AUTO).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: GTM protects initial ICP, onboarding, retention and buyer/user outcome evidence; pricing/brand owner approved.
records.acceptance: Real partner evidence before commercial GA (WORK).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Trust/safety detects and triages suspected fraud/abuse with proportionate scoped enforcement and audit.
records.acceptance: Suspicious activity throttle does not expose reporter or unrelated tenant (POL,AUTH).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Asset Management independently tracks domains/hosting/servers/repos/DNS/certificates/licenses/APIs/devices, owner/provider/client/project/entity/cost/purchase/renewal/expiry/warranty/lifecycle/reminders/audit.
records.acceptance: Each asset class survives transfer/expiry with scoped reminders; asset has secret reference, never value (AST,AUTH).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Import validates mapping, duplicates, scope, preview/dry-run, atomic/recoverable batches, reconciliation and reversible correction of a completed import without deleting posted truth.
records.acceptance: Bad row does not corrupt tenant; a completed bad import can be undone or compensated with audit and independent ledger reconciliation (DATA,TEN).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Secrets Vault separately enforces reference-only assets, least-privilege scoped capability access, environment isolation, rotation/revocation/expiry, audit and emergency rotation.
records.acceptance: Sentinel never in general AI/browser/log/export; revoked/wrong-env capability denied (VLT,AUTH).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Security incident response separately governs restricted evidence, containment, notification applicability, recovery and review linked to operational incident without exposing secret detail.
records.acceptance: Simulated breach keeps chain-of-custody; unauthorized status cannot declare report complete (SEC,OPS).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Retention, deletion, lawful hold and restore tombstones have versioned policy distinct from consent/rights intake.
records.acceptance: Expired media and derivative erased; lawful hold reviewed; restore does not resurrect (DATA,OPS).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Export/portability provides authorized machine-readable scoped data, source refs and explicit legal-retention/hold exception disclosure independently of import.
records.acceptance: Round-trip where defined; retained or excluded fields and their reviewable basis are disclosed without leaking restricted data (DATA,EXT).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Report/dispute/appeal lifecycle provides notice, reviewer separation, contestability and reversible proportionate remedy.
records.acceptance: False positive restored with evidence; disputant cannot self-approve (POL,AUTH).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Network integrity detects duplicate/fake profile and consent manipulation without cross-tenant raw pooling.
records.acceptance: Duplicate candidate review does not silently expose private HR data (POL,TEN).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Encrypt customer data in transit/at rest with scoped key management, environment/tenant separation, authorized rotation, revocation and restore procedure independently of Vault secret grants.
records.acceptance: Wrong-region/key principal cannot decrypt; rotation and backup restore preserve authorized access without plaintext log or permanent key loss (SEC,OPS).

records.family: Security, privacy, accessibility and market truth
records.requirement: Redact and control sensitive data egress to logs, prompts, traces, browser, support export and external processors by approved data class and purpose.
records.acceptance: Secret and personal-data sentinels never reach disallowed sink even on exception, retry, diagnostic dump or AI-off fallback (SEC,AI).
